summary: Devin for Startups gives early-stage teams $65K to build with the AI software engineer: $15K in Devin credits loaded into the account the day the startup is approved, plus a dollar-for-dollar match of up to $50K in grants on the next $100K of usage. Accepted startups also get unlimited Team-plan seats, invitations to founder meetups and early-access previews with the Cognition team, and a Devin swag pack. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
claim_steps: Create a Devin account at devin.ai.
Subscribe to the Team plan — no seat limits.
Apply at devin.ai/startups and tell Cognition about your startup.
Once approved, $15K in free credits hits your account immediately.

social_proof.author: nader dabit
social_proof.text: Devin for Startups gets you $65,000.00 in @DevinAI credits and grants, direct support from the @cognition team, and free swag. Submissions are open, I encourage you to apply!
